name: Ultra Addons for WPForms
author: Themefic

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ultra-addons-for-wpforms, or install directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WPForms → Ultra Addons in your dashboard.
  4. Enable the addons you need and start building.
  5. Check our documentation for setup guides.
sections.faq:
Do I need WPForms installed?

Yes. Ultra Addons works only when WPForms Lite is active.

Are addons free?

Yes. Phone Field, File Upload, Multi-Step Forms, Mailchimp, Repeater, Database, and URL Field are free.

How do I create a multi-step WPForm for free?

Enable our Multi-Step Form Addon to add steps and a progress bar.

Can I add file upload to WPForms without upgrading?

Yes. Turn on the File Upload Addon to allow users to upload documents, images, or resumes.

Can I save WPForms entries to the database?

Yes. The Database Addon stores and lets you export entries to CSV or Excel.

Does this plugin support Mailchimp?

Yes. Connect WPForms to Mailchimp and automatically add subscribers.

Can I create repeater fields in WPForms?

Yes. The Repeater Addon lets users add multiple repeating sections inside forms.

Do you offer Google Sheets integration?

Yes, Form entries sync directly to Google Sheets.

Do you support Zapier, Webhooks, or AWeber?

Yes. These integrations are available in the Pro addon bundle.

Does this work with Elementor and page builders?

Yes. All WPForms created with our addons work inside Elementor, Gutenberg, and other builders.

Will this change my existing WPForms?

No. Your forms and settings remain untouched.

How do I get support?

Visit https://wpfaddons.com/support/ for help or feature requests.

sections.description:
13+ Essential Addons for WPForms – Conditional logic, Google Sheets, Database, Mailchimp, Multi-Step Forms, Repeater, Webhooks, Zapier, and more!

Extend Your WPForms with Free and Essential Addons for WordPress

Unlock all features with Ultra Addons for WPForms Pro

👉 Official Demo: Visit Website
👉 Get Support: Submit a Ticket
👉 Documentation: View Docs
👉 Plugin Roadmap View Roadmap
👉 Join Our Facebook Community
👉 Join Our Community

If you use WPForms, Ultra Addons adds the most essential features users search for — multi-step forms, file upload, database storage, repeaters, phone field, Google Sheets, Mailchimp, and automation integrations.

FREE ADDONS INCLUDED

  • Advanced Phone Field – WPForms phone number field with country code & validation
  • Database Addon – Save WPForms entries to WordPress database
  • File Upload Field – Add file uploads to WPForms
  • Multistep Form Addon – Create WPForms multi-step forms
  • Mailchimp Integration – WPForms Mailchimp sync
  • Repeater Field – WPForms repeater field
  • Website URL Field – URL field for WPForms
  • Google Sheets Integration – WPForms to Google Sheets

PRO ADDONS INCLUDED

  • AWeber Integration – AWeber integration with WordPress
  • Google Drive Integration – WPForms Google Drive upload
  • WebHook Integration – WPForms webhook to external apps
  • Zapier Integration – WPForms Zapier automation
  • Conditional Fields – WPForms Conditional Fields

Free Version:

Advanced Phone Field

Advanced Phone Field allows you to collect accurate phone numbers with country codes, flags, and smart validation. Ideal for WPForms phone fields, contact forms, and international lead forms.

Database Addon

Database Addon saves WPForms entries to your WordPress database and lets you export them to CSV or Excel. Great for managing submissions, backups, reports, and exporting form data securely.

File Upload Field

File Upload Field lets users upload images, documents, resumes, and PDFs through WPForms. Includes file type validation and secure handling for job forms, quote forms, and contact forms.

Multistep Form Addon

Multistep Form Addon allows you to create multi-step WPForms with a progress bar. Perfect for surveys, booking forms, registrations, and long forms needing a clean multi-page layout.

Mailchimp Integration

Mailchimp Integration syncs WPForms submissions directly to your Mailchimp lists. Add tags, automate campaigns, and grow your audience with seamless Mailchimp + WordPress integration.

Repeater Field

Repeater Field adds dynamic repeater sections to WPForms so users can add multiple entries. Ideal for group registrations, team forms, multi-item submissions, and flexible repeatable fields.

Website URL Field

Website URL Field adds a clean website link field with automatic URL validation. Perfect for collecting business websites, portfolio URLs, and accurate website link fields in WordPress.

Google Sheets Integration

Google Sheets Integration sends WPForms entries directly to Google Sheets. Great for real-time spreadsheets, backups, analytics, and WordPress-to-Google Sheets automation.

Pro Version:

AWeber Integration

AWeber Integration connects WPForms to AWeber and sends form submissions directly from WordPress to AWeber. Perfect for anyone looking for AWeber integration with WordPress, automating subscribers, adding tags, and using AWeber with addons inside WPForms.

Google Drive Integration

Google Drive Integration uploads WPForms file attachments directly to Google Drive. Ideal for securely storing resumes, documents, and media while keeping your site lightweight.

Webhook Integration

Webhook Integration sends WPForms data to any external service using Webhooks. Connect to CRMs, automation tools, Pabbly, Make, ERPs, or custom APIs instantly.

Zapier Integration

Zapier Integration connects WPForms to 5,000+ apps using Zapier. Automate sending data to Google Sheets, Slack, CRMs, marketing tools, cloud storage, and more—no coding required.

Conditional Fields

Conditional Fields gives you full control over how users interact with your WPForms. Display or hide fields, sections, or entire form pages based on user choices—creating personalized, dynamic, and efficient form experiences.

MORE FEATURES COMING SOON

We’re already building powerful new addons and integrations, including:

  • Google Sheets Integration Pro
  • Conditional Logic Enhancements
  • Advanced Redirection Options
  • Payment Gateways
  • Automation Workflows

Stay tuned for future releases!

WHY YOU’LL LOVE ULTRA ADDONS FOR WPFORMS

  • 100% Free and beginner-friendly
  • Fully compatible with WPForms (Free & Pro)
  • Lightweight, fast, and performance-optimized
  • Drag-and-drop simplicity — no coding needed
  • Regular updates and new addons coming soon

START BUILDING SMARTER FORMS TODAY

If you’re already using WPForms, now’s the perfect time to enhance it with Ultra Addons for WPForms.
Install it today and unlock a smarter, faster, and more flexible form experience.

👉 Download the plugin and start exploring all free addons now.

Ultra Addons for WPForms — Extend. Simplify. Empower.
Build better forms, collect better data, and take WPForms beyond its limits.
